verdicts.note: Incumbent since the 2021 appointment [S5], elected in 2022 [S6], running on a documented in-office record (TrueFile, online calendars, Blake refunds) [S3]; more than 13 years in the local court system [S1]. Five years is modest tenure, but she is the race's proven-record case and the record is documented, so -2 high stands.

Challenger running to change how the office is run (turnover, training, consistency) [S2], but from inside the same court system as a former deputy clerk and current facilitator [S1][S2]; +1 medium is right, not +2.
